thread_relation: cross-warp, same block (first tile, tile_idx == 0); intra-warp-0 lane pairs also race
thread_pair_example: block 0: a lane of warp 0 whose rank is 96..99 stores items_shared[rank] (8-byte KeyValuePair) at bytes 8*rank = 0x300..0x31f, which overlaps scan_storage.warp_aggregates at 0x304..0x31b (discontinuity storage = 2 x 96 ints at 0x000..0x2ff, warp_scan = three empty WarpScanShfl::TempStorage at 0x300..0x302, warp_aggregates 4-byte aligned at 0x304; consistent with the builder's SASS reads LDS [R45.X8+0x304] for warp_aggregates[warp_id].key and LDS.128 [0x300]/[0x310]); warp 1 or 2 (thread 32 or 64) reads warp_aggregates[0..2] at agent_rle.cuh:455/:461/:469. Needs >= 97 non-trivial run starts in warp 0's range: the driver (key = i/2) has 240.
class_reason: all accesses are plain shared loads/stores (no volatile, no atomics).
buggy_expected: a shared-memory WAR data race (DR) between the warp_aggregates reads and the exchange stores on the first tile, reported across warps (and between lanes of warp 0).

fixed.reason: the fix adds CTA_SYNC() at the end of WarpScanAllocations() (agent_rle.cuh +4 lines): the fixed SASS has a BAR.SYNC at 0x19b0 directly after the LDS of the warp aggregates (0x1990); in the buggy SASS no barrier separates the reads from the exchange stores (next BAR at 0x2570).

sass_notes: buggy: BAR.SYNC 0x1920, then LDS.128 x2 (0x1960/0x1970, agent_rle.cuh:461) and LDS (0x1990, :455), no barrier, MEMBAR.SC.CTA at 0x1bb0 (single_pass_scan_operators.cuh:119), ..., STS.64 x15 at 0x2be0 (warp_exchange_smem.cuh:156). Kernel _ZN3cub...DeviceRleSweepKernel... in the driver. The non-time-sliced scatter lines (agent_rle.cuh:564/569) are not compiled for sm_89 in this policy (verify.corrections).
derived_from: verify.accesses + verify.thread_pair + verify.corrections of eval/realworld/targets.jsonl (cccl-2), re-checked against cub/cub/agent/agent_rle.cuh at eea703e (lines 448-472) and against nvdisasm -g of the built driver (eval/x_logs/sass-cccl-2-*.txt) on 2026-10-20
open_questions: verify.thread_pair's byte offsets were a hand calculation; the SASS shows warp_aggregates at 0x300.. (LDS.128 [0x300]) which is consistent with ranks 96-98 of the 8-byte exchange items, but the detector is the oracle for which lane pairs it reports.

Benign write-write pair outside the target, present in BOTH builds (added by the step-4 review): discarded items get rank WARP_THREADS*ITEMS_PER_THREAD = 480 (agent_rle.cuh:752-754 at eea703e) and WarpExchangeSmem stores them at items_shared[480] (warp_exchange_smem.cuh:156), one element past the 480-element array (:62-71, no padding for 15 items), i.e. over temp_storage.tile_idx/tile_inclusive (agent_rle.cuh:264-265, not read on the first tile). With key = i/2 every odd item is a non-head (agent_rle.cuh:385) and is discarded, so many lanes of the active warp store the same 8 bytes from different unrolled STS.64 instructions with no __syncwarp between them: an intra-warp WAW on one address. The fix does not touch it. A report warp_exchange_smem.cuh:156 vs :156 (WAW) on either build is this pair, not the oracle pair and not a fixed-build false positive.

review.notes: Checked at eea703e: Policy860 (selected for sm_89) = DefaultTuning = AgentRlePolicy<96, 15 (int), BLOCK_LOAD_DIRECT, LOAD_LDG, STORE_WARP_TIME_SLICING=true> (cub/cub/device/dispatch/tuning/tuning_run_length_encode.cuh:585-602,626-629), so ScatterTwoPhase<.., Int2Type<true>> runs (agent_rle.cuh:482-535) whenever tile_num_runs_aggregate >= 96 (:642; the driver's one tile has 720). Warp 0 calls ScatterToStriped on exchange_pairs[0] (:494-497) with no barrier after WarpScanAllocations (:446 is the last one; the first-tile path :715-769 has only thread-local code in between), while warps 1/2 may still read warp_aggregates (:455, :461, :469); scatter_aliasable and scan_storage are members of one union (:240-262). Fix ee14babe adds CTA_SYNC() after the loop ending at :470 (end of WarpScanAllocations); later slices are separated by CTA_SYNC (:504) and WarpExchange by WARP_SYNC (warp_exchange_smem.cuh:159), so the oracle pair is absent in the fixed build. Intra-warp lane pairs of warp 0 also exist. All accesses plain: DR. sass_notes are the builder's: the reviewer read sources and diffs only and did not re-dump SASS (the one srun queued with an estimated start the next day and was withdrawn).
